items.title: Human rights chief Türk renews call for end to spiralling Sudan war
items.description: The ongoing war in Sudan took centre stage at the UN Human Rights Council on Monday where the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Volker Türk, led calls for an end to attacks on civilians in “markets, hospitals [and] fuel stations”.

items.title: Long-awaited US visit to Kyiv brings no diplomatic breakthrough
items.description: After more than three hours of talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, US envoys traveled to Kyiv on Sunday. While Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky praised the talks as 'positive,' no details emerged about the US proposal intended to end the war.
